notes: Nkuku is a Shopify store (myshopify id 5782274146), direct HTTP fetch worked fine, no WAF/blocking, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (matches prior Home-Decor pass in notes/128.md). Checked: (1) full mega-menu / header nav on homepage (www.nkuku.com) for any 'Pet(s)' nav column or link -- none found, no /collections/*pet* URL appears anywhere in the rendered nav HTML. (2) Full /collections.json dump (783 collections across 4 paged fetches, limit=250) grepped for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten/feline/canine/paw keywords in handle+title -- found exactly 4 pet-named collections: gifts-for-pets (raw products_count=20), pet-accessories (raw=20), pet-beds-cushions (raw=14), pet-bowls (raw=6). None of these 4 are linked from the site nav -- they are orphaned/unlinked collection pages. (3) Verified each of the 4 via both /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (all returned {"products":[]}, i.e. 0) and the rendered collection page's own 'Product count' widget (all showed literal '0 items' in the live HTML). So the raw products_count field on these 4 is stale/inflated (consistent with the project-wide and prior-pass finding that Shopify's products_count is unreliable) -- the site's own live count is 0 for all four, so all are dropped per the zero-product rule; no rows emitted for them. (4) Site search (/search?q=pet&type=product, both the rendered HTML product count -- '3 items' -- and the predictive /search/suggest.json endpoint) returned only false-positive substring matches: 'PET Rug' (PET = polyethylene terephthalate, the rug material, not the animal), a wool cushion, a rabbit decoration, and 'Petrol' (colour name) -- no genuine pet-care product. (5) Checked sitemap.xml collections/products indexes exist normally; no separate pet-specific sitemap entries surfaced beyond the same 4 orphaned collections. Conclusion: Nkuku currently sells no live Pet Care products -- the site evidently once carried a small pet range (bowls, beds/cushions, accessories, pet gifts) that has since been fully sold through/discontinued, leaving only empty orphaned collection shells. No rows to emit.
